name: opencode-toolkit-mcp-redis-test
description: Test-only harness for the official redis-mcp-server PyPI package wired in by deploy/opencode.json.example (see docs/feature-points/20-redis-mcp-server.md) - no server code of our own here, this just verifies the upstream package behaves as documented (and as actually observed - see mcp-servers/redis/README.md's CLI-args-vs-env-vars note). The `redis` dependency is test-only, to seed/verify data independently of the tool under test - not something mcp-servers/redis/ itself depends on, since there's no code there.
